name_en: Ago Chikuwa — flying fish surimi grilled into a chikuwa with a crackling skin
summary_ja: 鳥取でトビウオを指す「あご」のすり身を焼き上げるちくわ。表面の硬い焼き皮に包丁を入れると香ばしい音が響き、色濃く仕上がるのが普通のちくわとの違い。産卵期の春から夏が旬の初夏の味覚という。
summary_en: Chikuwa made from the surimi of flying fish, called "ago" in Tottori. A knife through the firm grilled skin sends up a fragrant crackle, and it turns out darker than ordinary chikuwa. It's a taste of early summer, in season through the fish's spawning run from spring into summer.
source_title: あごちくわ 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
